limitations: No broad throughput acceptance: the positive 32-client result accompanies an eight-client regression.

samples.observation: Shared admission thread: 3018 samples, 465 under collection timed semaphore wait, 139 under collection cthread_yield. These are all-thread state samples, not CPU utilization or direct transaction latency attribution. Go uses goroutine scheduling; parked Go goroutines cannot be compared with parked Rust OS threads by these stack counts.
